P.56 defines a measurand (speech activity factor) and knowingly counts real non-speech as active; the operator is causal while the project's licence is two-sided - a crown detected in k0 and felled in k0+1 is written present through k0+I (the project's primary failure is the operator's defining behaviour); 'for the two-sided case a closing' substitutes field 9's operator; the anti-laundering bridge rule is the finder's synthesis (DESIGN-ONLY); extensivity FORMAL-BOUND but bounds the wrong direction; Kabal is secondary for P.56 and tertiary for the floor; extensivity survives as a constraint on any adopted heal
